title_zh: 预约查看顶棚报警器的间歇响声

scenario.goal_zh: 描述报警器的间歇响声，提供设备编号并约定上门检查时间

context_zh: 住户向楼管描述规律的短促鸣声；楼管确认需要当面查看，尚未声称完成维修。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: Something in my hallway makes a short noise every minute.

sentences.speaker: Building caretaker
sentences.text: Is it the bell beside your front door or the alarm on the ceiling?

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: The alarm. The sound is coming from above me, not from beside the door.

sentences.speaker: Building caretaker
sentences.text: Does the label on it have a number I can check?

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: Yes, it says H seventeen. I can read it from the floor.

sentences.speaker: Building caretaker
sentences.text: Thank you. I will come at four today to inspect it. Please leave it in place.

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: I will be home. Can you call when you reach the main entrance?

sentences.speaker: Building caretaker
sentences.text: Yes. I have your number, and I will check the unit when I arrive.
